product_overview: PrecificaPro is a construction project management and estimation web application that integrates with Supabase Auth for authentication, providing tools for project tracking, budget management, real-time dashboard metrics, and a construction cost calculator.
core_goals: Enable secure and flexible user authentication via Email, Google, and Apple providers.
Provide a comprehensive dashboard with key project statistics, active construction sites, revenue, and proposals overview.
Support efficient creation, management, and inspection tracking of construction projects with budget oversight.
Allow configuration of user profiles, company details including logo and CNPJ, theme preferences, and notification settings.
Deliver an intuitive, responsive layout with sidebar navigation and theme toggling.
Offer a construction cost estimation and pricing calculator tool to aid in project budgeting.
Integrate with Supabase Edge Functions and Gemini AI for advanced backend functionality.
key_features: Authentication module supporting Email, Google, and Apple login/signup via Supabase Auth.
Dashboard displaying project statistics, total revenue, open proposals, and active construction sites.
Project management module for creating, listing, updating, and inspecting construction projects and budgets.
Settings page for managing user profile, company information (such as logo and CNPJ), system themes (light/dark), and notification preferences.
Responsive app layout with sidebar navigation and theme toggle control for better user experience.
Construction cost estimation calculator to assist users in price calculations.
Integration utilities for calling Supabase Edge Functions and Gemini AI services for enhanced features.
user_flow_summary: User signs up or logs in using Email, Google, or Apple authentication providers.
Upon successful login, user is redirected to the Dashboard displaying their projects and metrics.
From the Dashboard, user navigates to Projects page to create or manage construction projects with budget and inspection details.
User configures personal profile, company details, themes, and notifications in the Settings screen.
User accesses Calculator tool to estimate construction costs and pricing based on project inputs.
Throughout, user benefits from a responsive UI with an accessible sidebar and can toggle between light and dark theme.
Backend integrations occur transparently via Supabase Edge Functions and AI-powered services.
validation_criteria: Authentication works seamlessly via all supported providers and restricts unauthorized access.
Dashboard loads and correctly displays all metrics fetched from backend services.
Project management functions allow creation, editing, deletion, and tracking of projects with budget and inspections.
Settings allow accurate updating and persistence of user profile, company info, themes, and notifications.
App layout adapts correctly on different screen sizes and maintains theme consistency with toggle.
Calculator tool performs accurate construction cost estimations reflecting input parameters.
Integration with Supabase Edge Functions and Gemini AI should be functional, with all calls returning successful results or meaningful error states.
